title: "Duplicate" context menu action, like in Dolphin
line: Desktop and Folder View icons now have a "Duplicate Here" menu item and Ctrl+D shortcut, like Dolphin.
explanation: Folder View (desktop and widget) only offered Cut, Copy and Rename for selected items; duplicating a file meant copying and pasting it, and Dolphin's Duplicate Here action had no counterpart. The change adds a "Duplicate Here" action (edit-duplicate icon, Ctrl+D) after Copy in the item context menu, using Dolphin's naming ("name copy.ext", auto-renamed to "name copy (1).ext" if taken) through an undoable KIO copy job. It is disabled when the folder isn't writable and hidden in the trash and for the trash icon.

commits.message:
containments/desktop: add a Duplicate Here action

Folder View had no way to duplicate items, unlike Dolphin. Add Dolphin's
"Duplicate Here" action to the item context menu and to Ctrl+D, copying
each selected item next to itself with "copy" added before its extension.

BUG: 448799
